name: thimble
description: Interactive cards of your data, citations a second Claude checks against your files, and explainers and heads-ups on each answer.

minimal.title: Minimal mode
minimal.description: Sets the rows below in one step, for plainer answers with fewer extras. Turn it off to put back the modes they had.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: A card is a chart or a table of the data behind an answer. Choose on demand when you would rather read answers as plain text. auto: Claude draws charts and tables of your data. on demand: Claude draws a card only when you ask for one. Press v for the last answer. off: no cards.

squeezeAnswers.title: Simplify
squeezeAnswers.description: Press s when an answer is too long or too technical, and a shorter, plainer version shows under it. Turn it off to take s off the bar.

catchUp.title: Catch-up
catchUp.description: When several replies came in since your last message, press b to read them as one note. Turn it off if you read each reply as it comes.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: A citation links words of an answer to the lines of your files they rest on. Choose an auto mode to have Claude cite every answer. auto + verify: Claude cites what each answer rests on. The verifier checks every citation after each answer. auto: Claude cites what each answer rests on. The verifier checks a citation when you open it. manual: select words and press c. The verifier checks them against your files. off: no citations.

checkerModel.title: Verifier model
checkerModel.description: The model of the verifier, a second Claude that checks each citation against your files. Pick a stronger model for harder checks, or a smaller one for faster checks. same as Claude: the model of the conversation. Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.2: that model, which reads the conversation without the cache of the conversation's model.

checkerEffort.title: Verifier effort
checkerEffort.description: How long the verifier thinks before it rules on a citation. Raise it for harder checks, or lower it for faster ones. same as Claude: the effort of the conversation. low, medium, high, xhigh or max: that effort, of the levels Claude Code offers for the verifier's model.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: An explainer is a short note on what a term in an answer means. Choose on demand to get one only for the words you select. auto: short notes on terms you may not know. on demand: select words and press e for a short note. off: no explainers.

details.title: Heads-ups
details.description: A heads-up flags a detail you should know before you rely on an answer. Turn it off to read answers without these notes. auto: notes on details that may mislead. off: no heads-ups.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: A label gives each record a value by a rule or a question, such as how each run ended. Turn it off if you do not want Claude to make labels.

claimsMode.title: Claims
claimsMode.description: The Claims pane lists what the session has concluded, grouped by topic. Turn it on to review a long analysis claim by claim. auto: everything the session concluded. on demand: everything the session concluded, when you press f in the pane. off: no Claims pane.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: The Coverage pane shows how much of each file Claude has read. Turn it on to see what an answer may have missed.
